NSCameraUsageDescription: CLAR uses the camera so you can photograph the litter you found, on the spot. The photo belongs to the report; only a copy with faces and number plates obscured is ever published.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CLAR accesses your photos so you can pick an existing picture for a report. We only read the image you choose, and we strip location and time from the image data before uploading.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CLAR uses your location only while you are using the app, to record where the litter was found. The public map shows a rounded position, never an exact point. There is no background location tracking.
